parameters.name: BackupSetId
parameters.description: The backup set ID.

parameters.name: Category
parameters.description:
The edition of the instance. Valid value:

- `enterprise`: Enterprise Edition

parameters.name: ClientToken
parameters.description: A client-provided token to ensure request idempotence. It must be unique across requests, contain only ASCII characters, and not exceed 64 characters in length.

parameters.name: DBInstanceDescription
parameters.description: The description of the instance.

parameters.name: DBTimeZone
parameters.description: The time zone of the database, which must be an IANA time zone identifier.

parameters.name: DeploySchema
parameters.description: The deployment mode of the instance.

parameters.name: Engine
parameters.description: The engine type.

parameters.name: EngineVersion
parameters.description: The engine version.

parameters.name: MultiZone
parameters.description: The multi-zone configuration.

parameters.name: NodeCount
parameters.description: The number of nodes. Valid values: 2 to 16. This parameter is required when you configure an elastic scaling range by using the `NodeScaleMin` and `NodeScaleMax` parameters.

parameters.name: NodeScaleMax
parameters.description: The maximum number of nodes for serverless elastic scaling. Valid values: 4 to 32. The value must be greater than the `NodeScaleMin` parameter.

parameters.name: NodeScaleMin
parameters.description: The minimum number of nodes for serverless elastic scaling. Valid values: 4 to 32.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region ID.

parameters.name: ResourceGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the resource group to which the instance belongs.

parameters.name: ScaleMax
parameters.description: This parameter is deprecated. Use the `NodeCount`, `NodeScaleMin`, and `NodeScaleMax` parameters to configure elastic scaling.

parameters.name: ScaleMin
parameters.description: This parameter is deprecated. Use the `NodeCount`, `NodeScaleMin`, and `NodeScaleMax` parameters to configure elastic scaling.

parameters.name: SourceDBInstanceId
parameters.description: The ID of the source instance. This parameter is required when restoring from a backup.

parameters.name: Tags
parameters.description: The tags to add to the instance.

parameters.name: VpcId
parameters.description: The VPC ID.

parameters.name: VswitchId
parameters.description: The vSwitch ID.

parameters.name: ZoneId
parameters.description: The zone ID.
